Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

January 7th 1916

C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No 8
Date 7 . 1 . 16

Sir,
With reference to the report that the detective responsible for the arrest of Ying Zen Sung 尹芸生 the wharf coolie, has been detained, yesterday the detective in question produced his informer, and was released on the joint security of the Arsenal detectives. The informer is named Tsu Kung San 周根三 He is now locked up. He has made no statement so far.
Regarding the petition of the merchants in the City concerning the proposed increase in the taxes on rice, bean and exchange shops, the City Magistrate has notified the Nantao Chamber of Commerce that the new taxes will not be imposed for the present.
It is reported that Mr. Chung Mun Yau 鍾文耀 Managing Director of the Shanghai Nanking Railway, has received telegraphic instructions from the Central Government to warn his subordinates to keep a sharp look out for persons conveying arms and ammunition by train.

Your Obedient Servant,

Wm Mushing
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）

1916年1月7日

刑事侦缉处
情报官登记簿
第8号
日期 16.1.7

先生：

关于负责逮捕码头苦力尹芸生（Ying Zen Sung）的侦探被拘留一事，据悉，该侦探于昨日带出其线人，并由兵工厂侦探联名担保后获释。该线人名叫周根三（Tsu Kung San），目前已被关押。迄今他尚未作出任何供词。

关于城内商人就拟议增加米店、豆行及钱庄税收一事所呈请愿书，城厢内政厅厅长已通知南市商会，新税项暂不征收。

据报，沪宁铁路总经理鍾文耀（Chung Mun Yau）先生已收到中央政府的电报指示，警告其下属严密注意通过火车运送军火的人员。

您顺从的仆人，

Wm Mushing
总探长

警务处总监
